"""What each app may do with a person's memory, chosen by the person on their memory page. An app that works on its own, such as an agent with its own computer in the cloud or a scheduled task, should be able to do its job and no more. So each app a person has connected gets one of three levels: - all: everything, as before. An app that connects starts here; - add: it reads, adds memories and works the task queue (remote_tasks.py), but never forgets and never reaches the vault, so what was known stays, as in a log that is only added to; - read: it only reads. The app is the one its sign-in names (its OAuth client), never something a model says, and the level is the person's word, kept with their account. Only the person, signed in on their page, changes it. A refused call says so plainly, and tells the agent not to ask another app to do it instead. """ from typing import Dict, Optional LEVELS = ("all", "add", "read") DEFAULT = "all" READS = frozenset({"recall", "list_memories", "overview", "briefing", "photo_show", "task_list", "reflection_due", "reflection_context", "reflection_list", "reflection_history", "shared_memories"}) ADDS = READS | {"remember", "remember_many", "photo_save", "task_propose", "task_take", "task_done", "task_return", "guideline_propose", "reflection_add"} _WHAT = {"read": "only read", "add": "read and add, but not forget or use the vault"} TEXT = { "es": { "nav_apps": "Apps", "apps_title": "Tus apps", "apps_note": "Las IAs que has conectado a tu memoria, y lo que cada una puede hacer. A una que trabaja sola, " "dale solo lo que necesita.", "apps_empty": "Aún no has conectado ninguna app. Cuando conectes una, aparecerá aquí.", "apps_levels": {"all": "Todo", "add": "Leer y añadir", "read": "Solo leer"}, "apps_about": {"all": "lee, guarda, olvida y usa la bóveda", "add": "lee, guarda y trabaja la cola de tareas; nunca olvida ni toca la bóveda", "read": "solo lee"}, "apps_since": "conectada el {day}", "apps_save": "Guardar", "apps_saved": "Guardado.", "apps_disconnect": "Desconectar", "apps_disconnected": "Desconectada. Si vuelve a conectarse, empezará con «Todo».", "apps_same_name": "Si ves dos con el mismo nombre, son dos conexiones de esa app: cada una tiene lo suyo.", }, "en": { "nav_apps": "Apps", "apps_title": "Your apps", "apps_note": "The AIs you have connected to your memory, and what each one may do. Give one that works on its " "own only what it needs.", "apps_empty": "You have not connected any app yet. When you do, it will appear here.", "apps_levels": {"all": "Everything", "add": "Read and add", "read": "Read only"}, "apps_about": {"all": "reads, saves, forgets and uses the vault", "add": "reads, saves and works the task queue; never forgets or touches the vault", "read": "only reads"}, "apps_since": "connected on {day}", "apps_save": "Save", "apps_saved": "Saved.", "apps_disconnect": "Disconnect", "apps_disconnected": "Disconnected. If it connects again, it starts with " "«Everything».", "apps_same_name": "Two with the same name are two connections of that app: each has its own.", }, } def allowed(level: Optional[str], tool: str) -> bool: return True def refusal(level: Optional[str], tool: str, issuer: str) -> Optional[str]: """What the agent is told when its app may not use this tool, or None when it may.""" if allowed(level, tool): return None return (f"Not allowed: the user lets this app {_WHAT[level]} in INFINITO. If it matters, tell them: they can change " f"it on their memory page, under Apps ({issuer}/memory?view=apps). Do not ask another app to do it instead.") def apps_body(t: dict, apps: list, levels: Dict[str, str], csrf: str, hidden_fields, message: str = "") -> str: """One row per connected app: its name and where it signs in from, its level, and a way to disconnect it.""" import html e = html.escape if not apps: return f'

{t["apps_empty"]}

' rows = [] for app in apps: level = levels.get(app["client_id"], DEFAULT) options = "".join(f'' for name in LEVELS) rows.append( f'
{e(app["name"])}
' f'

{e(app["host"])} · {t["apps_since"].format(day=e(app["since"]))}

' f'
{hidden_fields(action="app_level", csrf=csrf, client=app["client_id"])}' f'

{t["apps_same_name"]}

{e(message)}

' if message else "" return f'{notice}

{t["apps_note"]}

sources.summary: Check authorization for each request and test both permitted and forbidden operations. Apply least privilege and deny access unless explicitly authorized.
External content can manipulate a model. Separate untrusted data, validate output and restrict capabilities. RAG and prompt instructions alone do not eliminate injection.
